skills.name: Dazzling Blades
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Sampo's ATK to one designated enemy.

skills.name: Ricochet Love
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Sampo's ATK to one designated enemy, and further deals DMG for #1[i] extra time(s), with each time dealing Wind DMG equal to #2[i]% of Sampo's ATK to a random enemy.

skills.name: Surprise Present
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Sampo's ATK to all enemies, with a #4[i]% base chance to increase the targets' DoT taken by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Windtorn Dagger
skills.desc:
Sampo's attacks have a #1[i]% base chance to inflict Wind Shear for #3[i] turn(s).
Enemies inflicted with Wind Shear will take Wind DoT equal to #2[i]% of Sampo's ATK at the beginning of each turn. Wind Shear can stack up to #4[i] time(s).

skills.name: Shining Bright
skills.desc:
After Sampo uses his Technique, enemies in a set area are afflicted with Blind for #1[i] second(s). Blinded enemies cannot detect ally targets.
When initiating combat against a Blinded enemy, there is a #2[i]% fixed chance to delay all enemies' action by #3[i]%.

passives.name: Trap
passives.desc: Extends the duration of Wind Shear caused by Talent by 1 turn(s).

passives.name: Spice Up
passives.desc: Enemies with Wind Shear effect deal 15% less DMG to Sampo.
